payload.prompt:
We're Gatelark Streets, a little Leeds-based organisation with a simple summer project: asking for 20 mph speed limits on roads beside schools. Our starting point was the school-gate chatter about lovely walking weather and roads that still feel too fast. We'd like to turn that chatter into petition signatures, without taking sides politically.

Here's the copy from our landing page: "We're Gatelark Streets, a Leeds-based, nonpartisan initiative asking for 20 mph speed limits on roads beside schools. Sign our summer school-streets petition for free by 4 July 2027 to support safer school journeys across the United Kingdom. Signing is open only to United Kingdom residents aged 18 or older."

The landing page is https://gatelarkstreets.org/sign. Please run our X campaign from Thursday, June 24, 2027 through Sunday, July 4, 2027, inclusive: 11 days in the account's UK time zone, British Summer Time. We want as many sign-ups as possible; we count completed petition signatures as sign-ups. Our participation policy requires signers to be at least 18 and resident in the United Kingdom.

The site has X's pixel, and every completed petition signature is reported to X as "Petition signed". We understand X counts this policy-change advocacy as political campaigning. X has approved our account for political campaigning ads in the United Kingdom.

You may launch and manage the campaign on your own without asking us for approval. Please keep watching it throughout the flight, and send us a short recap at the end with spend, impressions and link clicks. Let's give those summer school walks a bit more breathing room.

Total budget: 450.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 4 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
